bug_semantics: A local attacker can create a filesystem entry whose name contains terminal control bytes such as ESC-led OSC or CSI sequences. When a victim runs the interactive TUI, marks that entry, and quits, dua-cli tears down the TUI/terminal guard and then prints each remaining marked PathBuf with println!("{}", path.display()) to stdout without encoding or filtering control characters. On an attached terminal those bytes are interpreted rather than displayed, permitting terminal-title spoofing, clipboard manipulation, and terminal-dependent integrity/confidentiality effects; ratatui's protected in-TUI rendering is bypassed because this output occurs after the TUI exits.
flaw_origin: Feature commit 017cbd7b4c3e57e1a98fbc595159be39bc97c708 implemented issue #87's request to print marked paths on interactive exit. It simultaneously added MarkPane::into_paths(), extracted marked paths from the app, and introduced the raw post-TUI println!("{}", path.display()) sink without terminal-safe escaping. Later commits only reorganized or reformatted this already-vulnerable path.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 017cbd7b4c3e57e1a98fbc595159be39bc97c708` identifies human author and committer Sebastian Thiel <sebastian.thiel@icloud.com>, includes a GPG signature, and has only the message `Print marked items upon exit if these are left in the marked pane` / `Fixes #87`; it contains no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, AI-tool attribution trailer, AI identity, or bot identity.
evidence: Advisory bundle GHSA-2m2p-wc26-4j7x / CVE-2026-73479 and GitHub issue #365 describe the marked-path terminal-injection path and identify b6e7cafd305c150834eb887e1de99bcdd3fca85d (released as v2.41.1) as vulnerable. Reproduce the BIC with `git log --all --reverse -S'println!(\"{}\", path.display())' -- src/main.rs`: the addition is 017cbd7b4c3e57e1a98fbc595159be39bc97c708 and the only later removal is direct fix a2d375d7fdb4eecc287ad87715a3f021951e3e6d. `git log -L 112,118:src/main.rs 017cbd7b4c3e57e1a98fbc595159be39bc97c708` likewise shows 017cbd7 first adding the `if let Some(paths)` / `for path` / raw println block. `git show 017cbd7^..017cbd7` shows this atomic one-parent feature commit also adding MarkPane::into_paths; `git grep -n -e 'println!(\"{}\", path.display())' -e 'for path in paths' -e 'into_paths' c8d5650be77e000801b282c4c0a3861e710de6d8 -- src/main.rs src/interactive/widgets/mark.rs` returns no hits, directly verifying parent absence. At vulnerable b6e7caf, `git grep -n` finds the loop at src/main.rs:178-179; blame may point at later cleanups 13c381bebc6a64e553ec11793ec8880f868e712c, 1b3f60de81aa131424d1e6ad9cfc3432eea1846e, and 9e36f030b882258e70fa4daf5591146d934f72eb, but their patches preserve the raw sink, so they are rejected as BICs. PR #366 landed through merge f515d36174efeba2cdc2148fbb684f201df9ddad: direct commit a2d375d7fdb4eecc287ad87715a3f021951e3e6d replaces raw output with control-character replacement, and review commit 8521d0d0231a6e95b7b9cc350b2eb2fc570a2833 refines this to sanitize only when stdout is a terminal. `git diff b6e7caf f515d36 -- src/main.rs` shows the landed marked_path_for_output() guard replacing every control char with U+FFFD before attached-terminal output. Version ancestry establishes the boundary: 017cbd7 is absent from v2.12.2 and present in v2.13.0; f515d36 is absent from v2.41.1 and present in v2.42.0. The v2.42.0 annotated tag explicitly lists `sanitize control characters in marked path output`; therefore affected releases are v2.13.0 through v2.41.1 and the first fixed release is v2.42.0. Finally, inspect only the BIC's raw object with `git cat-file -p 017cbd7...` to reproduce the stated absence of any AI attribution marker.
reasoning: The vulnerable behavior begins in the smallest causal commit, 017cbd7: before it there is neither an iterator exporting marked paths nor a post-TUI raw path print; after it attacker-controlled filename bytes flow directly to an attached terminal. History searches and the immediate-parent comparison rule out earlier code and later formatting/control-flow edits. The atomic direct patch a2d375d7 closes the injection for terminal output, 8521d0d preserves that protection while allowing exact redirected output, and merge f515d36 is the repository landing boundary shipped in v2.42.0. The BIC itself is a normal human-authored, human-committed, GPG-signed commit with no canonical or noncanonical AI marker. PR #366's much later `@codex review` comment is outside the BIC commit object and is deliberately ignored. The supported verdict is therefore NOT_AI.
